import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, tarfile
from pathlib import Path

checkout = Path("<checkout>")
contrib = Path("<workspace>/meta-lts-collab")
store = Path("<store>")
lws_tmp = Path("<workspace>/lws-4.2.2-check")

if lws_tmp.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(lws_tmp)

patch_pairs = [
    (
        checkout / "recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-1.patch",
        contrib / "meta-oe/recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-1.patch",
    ),
    (
        checkout / "recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-2.patch",
        contrib / "meta-oe/recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-2.patch",
    ),
]

diff_comparisons = []
for sample_p, contrib_p in patch_pairs:
    s_txt = sample_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    c_txt = contrib_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    s_diff = s_txt.split("\n---\n", 1)[1]
    c_diff = c_txt.split("\n---\n", 1)[1]
    assert s_diff == c_diff, f"Diff body diverged for {sample_p.name}"
    diff_comparisons.append({
        "patch": sample_p.name,
        "sample_sha256": hashlib.sha256(s_txt.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "contributed_sha256": hashlib.sha256(c_txt.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "diff_payload_identical": True,
        "diff_payload_sha256": hashlib.sha256(c_diff.encode()).hexdigest(),
    })

subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(lws_tmp)], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/warmcat/libwebsockets.git"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "fetch", "-q", "--depth", "1", "origin", "8d605f0649ed1ab6d27a443c7688598ea21fdb75"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "checkout", "-q", "FETCH_HEAD"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "config", "user.name", "Jabar Asadi"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "config", "user.email", "azhovan@outlook.com"], check=True)

for _, contrib_p in patch_pairs:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "apply", "--check", "--whitespace=error", str(contrib_p)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "am", "--quiet", str(contrib_p)], check=True)

am_log = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(lws_tmp), "log", "-n", "3", "--oneline"], text=True).strip().splitlines()
shutil.rmtree(lws_tmp)

task_logs_tar = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/libwebsockets-task-logs.tar"
do_patch_excerpt = None
with tarfile.open(task_logs_tar, "r:") as archive:
    for m in archive.getmembers():
        if m.isfile() and m.name.endswith("/log.do_patch") or ("log.do_patch." in m.name and m.isfile()):
            do_patch_excerpt = archive.extractfile(m).read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            break

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "verified",
    "upstream_srcrev_tested": "8d605f0649ed1ab6d27a443c7688598ea21fdb75",
    "diff_comparisons": diff_comparisons,
    "git_am_commits_on_4_2_2": am_log,
    "sti110_do_patch_fuzz_warnings": ("fuzz" in (do_patch_excerpt or "").lower()),
    "sti110_do_patch_log": (do_patch_excerpt or "").strip(),
}, indent=2))

argv:
import subprocess

title = "libwebsockets: Fix CVE-2026-19773"
body = """Backport the upstream server-side HTTP/2 HPACK `:path` bounds checks for `CVE-2026-19773` ([ZDI-26-590](https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-590/), discovered by Maher Azzouzi working with TrendAI Zero Day Initiative) to `meta-oe` `libwebsockets` `4.2.2`:

1. [`824151862f37bc72f46d9a3e01d5b9408d313a0b`](https://github.com/warmcat/libwebsockets/commit/824151862f37bc72f46d9a3e01d5b9408d313a0b) (`Andy Green`): checks `(unsigned int)ah->pos >= wsi->a.context->max_http_header_data` before writing to `ah->data` in `lws_frag_append()` (`lib/roles/h2/hpack.c`).
2. [`0c6cef0922c531f2662e87e74e17c191fa18162b`](https://github.com/warmcat/libwebsockets/commit/0c6cef0922c531f2662e87e74e17c191fa18162b) (`Feng Xue`): checks `(unsigned int)ah->pos >= wsi->a.context->max_http_header_data` immediately after `ah->frags[ah->nfrag].offset = ++ah->pos;` when `?` starts `WSI_TOKEN_HTTP_URI_ARGS` in `lws_parse_urldecode()` (`lib/roles/http/parsers.c`).

### Validation and scope

- **Local layer checks**: Validated against `requirements-dev.txt` (`oelint-adv 9.11.3`, `ruff 0.17.5`, `yamllint 1.38.0`), `meta-lts-collab-test/scripts/get-bitbake-targets.py`, and clean zero-fuzz patch application onto `libwebsockets` `4.2.2` (`SRCREV = 8d605f0649ed1ab6d27a443c7688598ea21fdb75`).
- **Paired target validation (`qemuarm64`)**: Validated on Poky `4.0.35` (`93431249a6260da7bd29ee3ca32145d89e5b8259`), `meta-openembedded` `kirkstone` (`ce8539c941f6fcbecaca4d16640ac105c0595589`), and `garmin/meta-lts-collab` `kirkstone` (`e127ed67e74ca6b7e0fdc6cbda572302886c00a0`) with default `PACKAGECONFIG` (`libuv client server http2 ssl`) enabled. System-mode `qemuarm64` tests reproduced the `lws_frag_append()` heap out-of-bounds write across `max_http_header_data` boundary and delimiter (`?`, `;`) vectors on the unpatched build and verified clean bounds rejection, post-attack HTTP/2 `200` liveness, and `libwebsockets-testapps` regressions on the patched build (reference test harness and build evidence: [`firmdura/meta-firmdura-kirkstone`](https://github.com/firmdura/meta-firmdura-kirkstone)).
- **CI architecture note**: Our local build and runtime validation ran on `qemuarm64`; `meta-lts-collab` PR CI covers `yocto-check-layer` and `qemux86-64` `core-image-minimal` builds/`do_testimage` across `sysvinit` and `systemd`."""

subprocess.run([
    "gh", "pr", "create",
    "--repo", "garmin/meta-lts-collab",
    "--base", "kirkstone",
    "--head", "firmdura:kirkstone-libwebsockets-cve-2026-19773",
    "--title", title,
    "--body", body,
], check=True)

argv:
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("<checkout>")
store = Path("<store>")
doc_path = repo / "docs/contribution.md"
run_path = repo / "evidence/20261118-sti114-contribution/run.json"

doc = doc_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
run_raw = run_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
run_data = json.loads(run_raw)

host_prefix = chr(47) + "Users" + chr(47)
assert host_prefix not in doc
assert host_prefix not in run_raw
assert not re.search(r"STI-\d+", doc, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
for forbidden in ["sub-agent", "subagent", "worker", "project lead", "lead brief", "linear.app"]:
    assert forbidden not in doc.lower(), forbidden

def slugify(heading: str) -> str:
    s = heading.strip().lower()
    s = re.sub(r"`", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", s)
    return s

checked_links = []
for m in re.finditer(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)", doc):
    target = m.group(1)
    if target.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        continue
    rel_part, _, frag = target.partition("#")
    resolved = (doc_path.parent / rel_part).resolve()
    assert resolved.exists(), f"Broken local link: {target}"
    if frag and resolved.suffix == ".md":
        headings = {
            slugify(line.lstrip("#").strip())
            for line in resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.startswith("#")
        }
        assert frag in headings, f"Missing anchor #{frag} in {resolved.name}"
    checked_links.append(target)

assert {"schema_version", "run_id", "issue", "status", "started_at", "finished_at", "inputs", "commands", "artifacts", "results", "limitations", "timing"} <= run_data.keys()
for cmd in run_data["commands"]:
    log_file = store / cmd["log"].removeprefix("local://firmdura-kirkstone/")
    assert log_file.stat().st_size == cmd["log_size"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(log_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == cmd["log_sha256"]
    dt = (datetime.fromisoformat(cmd["finished_at"]) - datetime.fromisoformat(cmd["started_at"])).total_seconds()
    assert abs(dt - cmd["elapsed_seconds"]) < 1e-6

expected_sample_hashes = {
    "conf/layer.conf": "0db7333de22c5c7a4c55eb3622f93255513d527a8a145ed801f9fa03056f77a3",
    "kas/common.yml": "c963dc518cb5243858366dce7b34a0afb8201d8189bc47070f71f9b092ca4dfd",
    "recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets_4.2.2.bbappend": "5291c38e09b0af0a7c778a3dde48d7fbb3e6e224597007b5d2959c6c55b7df40",
    "recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-1.patch": "a13f788fab3a5bf06435e18ffe1e46e4570e49ac57fcd94befceef896e15b382",
    "recipes-connectivity/libwebsockets/libwebsockets/CVE-2026-19773-2.patch": "3bc3975d8469aeea38f4a2851299479cade104abfe9029d3ace9e59ae0eafcfa",
}
for rel, exp in expected_sample_hashes.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((repo / rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == exp

assert (store / "artifacts/20261117-sti108-baseline/deploy.tar").stat().st_size == 1977942016
assert (store / "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/deploy.tar").stat().st_size == 1992468480

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "verified",
    "checked_local_links": len(checked_links),
    "zero_host_paths": True,
    "zero_ticket_ids_in_public_doc": True,
    "frozen_inputs_and_deploy_archives_intact": True,
}, indent=2))
